name: onik-portfolio
description: Personal portfolio platform with a built-in CMS (React + Express + MongoDB)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.dev:memory: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:memory --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix server --omit=dev && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
